properties.title: About the workflow
properties.content:
Image to Video

Upload a starting image and a prompt, and the model animates it into a short video. Add an optional end frame to set where it lands. That's it.

Open source, so you only pay for generation time.
All models pre-loaded on Floyo.

Model

  • Wan 2.2 14B by Alibaba. An open source video model that turns a still image into smooth, natural motion.
  • LightX2V LoRA. Cuts generation down to a few steps for speed.

Heavy workflow. Expect longer generation times.

properties.title: Inputs you need
properties.content:
Start frame

  • The image your video begins from.

End frame

  • Optional. An image for the video to finish on. Leave it empty to let the motion play out freely.

Prompt

  • Describe the motion you want. Say what moves and how.
Upload a start frame, write a prompt, hit run.

properties.title: Settings
properties.content:
All optional. Defaults work well.
  • Resolution: (default: 832x480). The video size. Larger is sharper but slower.
  • Length: (default: 53 frames). How long the video runs.
  • Frame rate: (default: 16). How many frames play per second.
  • Steps: (default: 6). How many passes the model makes. The speed LoRA keeps this low.
  • Seed: (default: fixed). A number that controls the randomness. Change it for a different take, keep it to reproduce one.
